expect.means: The mod's quest script writes this line at every new game and every load. If it is missing, the quest never ran.
The quest reached stage 10, when the player first reached a spaceport.
The quest reached stage 20, when the player read the letter.
The quest reached its last stage and finished.

forbid.means: A stage was set before the stage that must come first, for example by a console setstage.
